live_ticking_profit.description: Smooth live counter ticking for XRP yield accrual in realtime using requestAnimationFrame or 100ms interval.
live_ticking_profit.visual_feedback: Subtle green pulse or light glow shift on monetary digit updates without jumping screen position.

motion_and_interactions.landing_reveals: Framer Motion staggered opacity and slide-up transitions (duration 0.5s, easeOut).

micro_interactions.hover: Scale 1.02 on vault cards and key CTAs
micro_interactions.modal_fade: Smooth spring transition for PIN unlock and mnemonic wallet phrase modal screens

app_hero_mockup.description: Hand holding phone showing cryptocurrency trends with coins in the background for hero app mockup.

mobile_dashboard_screen.description: Phone displaying real-time financial tracking app interface.

security_vault_bg.description: Smartphone with financial data on dark table near scattered coins.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, modals, tables, metrics) MUST have kebab-case `data-testid` attributes (e.g. data-testid="deposit-xrp-button", data-testid="user-balance-amount").
accessibility_and_testing.contrast_wcag: Text contrast maintained above 4.5:1 on dark slate surfaces. Interactive focus outlines using bright electric blue rings.
accessibility_and_testing.keyboard_nav: Full support for Enter/Space triggers, ESC key modal dismissals, tab order across PIN login and registration steps.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure dark near-black aesthetic (#07090E) with bright electric blue accents (#2563EB / #3B82F6) and glowing borders across all pages.
Header and dropdowns MUST NEVER have completely transparent backgrounds; always use `backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0D111A]/90 border border-white/10`.
Implement data-testid on all interactive buttons, inputs, vault selection cards, tabs, and user profile actions.
Ensure monetary values use JetBrains Mono or tabular nums so live profit ticking doesn't jitter layout.
Support both desktop layout and PWA installable mobile feel with bottom nav or responsive app frame where applicable.
Adhere strictly to .js/.jsx React frontend setup without introducing breaking type definitions.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic AI purple slop gradients.
Use layered ambient shadows with crisp border-white/10 highlights for depth.
Micro-interactions on every button, link, and interactive card.
Include high-contrast badges for VIP tiers and deposit statuses.
All test ids MUST follow kebab-case naming convention.
